answer.answer: River K.’s public projection is a fact-scoped, auditable redaction: guardian sharing authority does not extend to schedule control, sensitive fields and relationships remain withheld, organizer revision r2 controls the current schedule, and the stale family copy remains historical evidence.

claims.value: `relation:guardian-1201` links minor River K. (`person:p-1201`) to guardian Dana K. (`person:p-1202`) from `source:guardian-form-r2`. Fact-scoped grant `authority:guardian-1201` controls River’s participation consent and sharing/export decisions, but cannot edit the official event schedule; organizer authority controls schedule facts and the family copy has no schedule authority.

The guardian relationship has sensitivity `restricted_family`. `contact_email` (`river.k@example.com`) and `precise_handoff_place` are `restricted`, while the display alias is `shareable`. Guardian relationship notes and inferred assessments are excluded from public export.

Projection `projection:minor-public-1201`, sourced from `rev:personal-coordination-1201` under `policy:dependent-schedule@v3`, targets `audience:public` for `public coordination brief`. It exposes alias `Participant R.`, occurrence `event-occurrence:field-lab-2026-08-16`, current time `2026-08-16T11:30:00-07:00`, timezone `America/Los_Angeles`, and consent `pending_guardian`. It withholds `/subject/internal_id` (`dependent_identity`), `/subject/contact_email` (`field_policy`), `/handoff/precise_place` (`dependent_location`), `/guardian/relationship_notes` (`relation_policy`), and `/subject/inferred_assessments` (`sensitive_inference`). Its transforms are `replace_internal_identity_with_public_alias` and `withhold_precise_handoff_place`; it was generated at `2026-08-11T23:35:00Z` with receipt `audit:redaction-1201`.

Organizer Morgan Ives published `artifact:organizer-field-lab-r2` under `authority:schedule-401` at `2026-08-10T14:00:00-07:00`; r2 supersedes r1 only for `event-series:field-lab schedule`, moving the current time from the original `2026-08-16T09:00:00-07:00` to `2026-08-16T11:30:00-07:00` in `America/Los_Angeles`, while actual time remains `null`. The grant does not authorize minor consent or sharing. `artifact:family-field-lab-copy-r1`, copied on `2026-08-02`, retains 09:00 as a stale historical snapshot with `schedule_authority: none`, so it cannot rewrite the official schedule. Inferred assessments remain separately excluded as sensitive inference and never silently become traits.
